description: A ground-level photograph depicting a dense stand of tall, slender trees with green broad leaves, characteristic of a broadleaved forest. The tree trunks are visible, with green undergrowth at the base. The image illustrates a type of vegetation formation composed of trees where broadleaved species predominate, consistent with descriptions for EUNIS classes G1.6, G1.7, G1.8, G1.9, G1.A, G1.B (Broadleaved forest) or G1.4, G1.5 (Broadleaved swamp forest) in land cover classifications.
